PLURAL_HINTS: Most words add s. Words ending in s, x, sh or ch add es.
If a consonant comes before the y, change y to i and add es. If a vowel comes before the y, just add s.
For many words ending in f or fe, change the f to v and add es: leaf → leaves. A few just add s: roof → roofs.
Some words change in a special way (mouse → mice), some stay the same (one moose, two moose), and words ending in o add s or es (potatoes, pianos).
ENDING_HINTS: Just add the ending to the word.
When a word ends in a silent e, drop the e before adding ing or ed.
Short vowel, one consonant at the end? Double the last letter before adding ing or ed.
